Send the investor updates you have sent since your first outside money, as the original emails or PDFs, with send dates.
Send monthly revenue by customer so we can rebuild retention, plus the cohort export behind the deck's retention number and a one-line definition of a cohort.
Please send statements for every business bank account for the last 12 months, downloaded straight from the bank, or give read-only access through your bank.
Please send the hiring plan for the next 12 to 18 months: role, department, start date, base pay and equity grant for each planned hire.
Please send the current monthly burn and the bank balance behind it, with the date.
Send monthly sales and marketing spend by line and channel, new paying customers by month and by source, and how the deck defines CAC, LTV and payback.
Please send names and contacts for three customers we can call, including your largest and one who stopped using the product, plus any letters of intent.

Send an opportunity-level export from your CRM with deal name, amount, stage, created date, expected close date, source, last activity and next step, including closed-lost deals, for the last six to eight quarters.
Please send names of people who have worked with the founders that we could call.
Please send: Reference list: management, customers, current investors, advisors.
the option grant records for every holder
Please send the signed SAFE, with any side letter, for each of: Theodora Vance (angel); Wickham Row Angels LLC; Halyard Pre-Seed Fund I, LP.
Please send the one-page summary you give investors, with its date.
Please send a recorded demo or a login to a sandbox, and a one-page roadmap with dates and owners. Say which parts of the demo are live.
Please send the latest 409A report and the one before it, the option grant ledger with grant dates and strike prices, and the board approval for each grant.

Please send the filed certificate of incorporation with every amendment, the current bylaws, the organizational board consent, the founders' stock purchase agreements and 83(b) elections, and a good standing certificate dated within the last few months.

Please send the signed invention assignment agreements for each founder (covering any work before incorporation), each employee and each contractor who has written code, designs or content, and a list of anyone who has not signed.
Please send the board and stockholder consents or minutes that approved each SAFE, note, stock issuance and option grant, the equity plan, and the 409A report.
Please send the federal and state income tax returns filed since incorporation with proof of filing, the payroll tax filings, and the Delaware annual report and franchise tax receipts.

Please send a short written statement of any pending or threatened lawsuit, demand letter, dispute with an employee, contractor, customer or regulator, and any regulatory inquiry, settlement or order, or state that there are none.

Please send a schedule of every agreement with obligations over $25,000 and copies for your ten largest vendors; your lease; any loan, note or credit agreement with the lender's lien filings; your insurance policies and certificates, including D&O; and the agreements with any consultants or contractors, with their IP assignments.
Please send: Loans, liens and other encumbrances on the company.
Please send: Patents, trademarks, copyrights and domain names.

Please send a one-page note on which AI models and vendors the product uses, what data any model was trained or tuned on and your rights to it, how customer and call data is used and kept, and the agreement with each AI vendor.
Please send: Licences of the company's IP to others, and of other people's IP to the company.
Please send: Agreements that need a third party's consent, or carry change-of-control terms, because of this financing.
